## ===== SDK RELEASE STREAM — READ FOR THE FIRST TIME SINCE v3.0.0 =====
## The 2026-08-21 scan did not read this stream at all. FOUR releases were unexamined.
## THIS IS A sources.json GAP: no source points at the SDK releases; this cache tracked it by hand.

- **v3.3.1 (Aug 19, 2026)** — security fixes + build tooling migration only.        [below bar]
- **v3.3.0 (Aug 18, 2026)** — "support named data-residency endpoints"; dependency updates.
                                                                                    [below bar]
- **v3.2.0 (Aug 17, 2026)** — **"add Bedrock Runtime endpoint support (SDK-290)"**
                            — "Add shell call streaming events and new service/image types"
  => THE REPORTABLE ONE. Cross-provider routing is no longer confined to Codex CLI (0.148.0,
     reported 2026-08-21) — it is now in THE LIBRARY ANY APPLICATION USES, so arbitrary production
     workloads can target Bedrock. Compounds two known blind spots:
       (a) Anthropic's Compliance API explicitly does NOT capture Claude Code routed through
           Bedrock / Google Cloud / Microsoft Foundry;
       (b) as of 2026-08-21 `bedrock-runtime` serves the Anthropic Messages API on `/anthropic`
           and the OpenAI shapes on `/openai/v1`.
     => OpenAI-SDK app + Bedrock Runtime + a Claude model = traffic OpenAI never sees, Anthropic's
        compliance surface never captures, and AWS receives in a foreign wire format.
     RULE: per-vendor telemetry cannot establish coverage once vendors' own SDKs route to each
     other's endpoints. The only reliable vantage point is the cloud account's own logging.
  => "shell call streaming events" implies a COMMAND-EXECUTION surface in the streaming schema —
     track for parser work.                                    [reported 2026-08-23, MEDIUM/AIDR]
- **v3.1.0 (Aug 14, 2026)** — "add WebSocket stream IDs"; **"add workload identity access token
  issued event"**; Sora video APIs marked deprecated.          [schema items, held — parse them]
- v3.0.0 (Aug 12, 2026) — BREAKING: migrate to HTTPX2.                    [held 2026-08-14]
- v2.54.0 (Aug 11, 2026) — new Responses model identifiers.               [held 2026-08-14]

Standing caution (2026-08-07): SDK release-note wording lags and MISLABELS model families —
corroborate model launches against openai.com/index/* and the ChatGPT/Codex changelog.
NEW caution (2026-08-23): `github.com/openai/openai-python/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md` renders GitHub
chrome only via WebFetch. Use `/releases` or `/releases/tag/<version>`.
